instruction: Apply italic formatting to all text within the textboxes on slides 4 and 5

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires applying italic formatting to all text in textboxes on slides 4 and 5 (0-indexed: 3 and 4). Slide 4 has 7 textboxes with text, slide 5 has 2 textboxes with text. Evaluator checks italic formatting and provides partial credit based on the proportion of textboxes with italic text applied.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly implements ALL italic checking: For each textbox, it verifies that ALL runs have font.italic == True (not just ANY run). Logic at pptx.py:44-57 uses 'all_italic = True' with 'if run.font.italic is not True: all_italic = False; break', which correctly validates complete italic formatting.
Proper edge case handling: Skips empty textboxes (line 41-42), only checks runs with actual text (line 49), treats None as not italic (line 53), and returns False if no text runs exist (line 60-61).
Metric correctly calculates partial credit: Returns italic_textboxes / total_textboxes, providing proportional scoring for multi-textbox scenarios.
Complete instruction coverage: Evaluator verifies italic formatting for all textboxes on the specified slides (3 and 4, which are 0-indexed slides 4 and 5).
Proper state management: Postconfig includes Ctrl+S to save the file before reading, ensuring fresh state access.
